legend.meaning: Curated pathways of plant perception — how plants sense their surroundings and their own state, from stimulus to receptor to response — each stage tied to a verified published abstract.
stimulus → transducer → cascade → signal_route → integration → response (pack-supplied stage kinds; A5.2).
A = quoted or closely tracked from a verified abstract · K = curator knowledge, not verified against an abstract
B1 established · B2 partial · B3 unknown or inferred; set in curation
curated = accepted in curation; only curated rows are shown as paths
dual membership or a proposed (not established) mechanism, as in PPE
all / some / none: computed from references.json (OpenAlex title ratio ≥ 0.85, PPE app-methods §1.2)
Arabidopsis thaliana unless stated. Rows from other species (senses Arabidopsis lacks, e.g. nodulation) say so, 'NOT Arabidopsis' (Daniel, 2026-11-18)
a gap: no verified source supports this stage yet
